_comment: Example SCOPED APPROVAL RECORD. Copy into .agent-runs/approvals/<name>.json (global) or .agent-runs/sessions/<session-id>/approvals/<name>.json (session-scoped) to authorize a single gated action. The hooks check these BEFORE the deprecated broad flags. Keep tool_pattern as narrow as possible. expires_at is compared lexically as UTC ISO-8601 (use the Z suffix). single_use approvals are consumed on first match (a sibling <name>.json.consumed marker is written).
